Fernando Couto, Centre Back (CB), born 02-08-1969 in Espinho, Portugal. 1.83m. FIFA Matches 110, FIFA Goals 8. Club seasons include FC Porto (1987/88, 1990/91-1993/94), Famalicao and Academica in between, AC Parma (1994/95-1995/96, 2005/06-2007/08), FC Barcelona (1996/97-1997/98) and Lazio Roma (1998/99-2004/05).

notes: Wrong-answer-only profile researched to close the same Figo-era Portugal contemporary gap. Both sources agree on Porto as the first senior system club (with Famalicao/Academica/Porto's second spell simplified out of the bank's plain club list) and the later Parma/Barcelona/Lazio/Parma chronology.
